tragedy-of-commons-pasture.alt: Left: a bar chart for one herder who adds one cow to a pasture shared by 10 herders. The gain bar is 100% of one cow's value, because the herder keeps the whole cow. The cost bar is 10%, because the lost grass is shared by all 10 herders. Right: a loop. Each herder adds cows, grass is eaten faster than it regrows, bare soil erodes, and there is less grass for every herd.
